# The Long Way

*Perrin wants the Dark Stumps on the Rootlands thinned so he can ride the short way to the Tree. Then tell his cousin Tilda he took it.*

|  |  |
|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Defeat 30 Dark Stump on the Rootlandss ([Dark Stump](../monsters/dark_stump.md)) in [The Rootlands](../maps/rootlands.md)
2. Talk to [Tilda](../npcs/tilda.md)

## Rewards

- 2,000 EXP
- 400 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +25 standing with Selsior
- +120 standing with [Perrin](../npcs/perrin.md)
